decisions.reason: As a flagship adjacent to our core wafer and packaging capabilities, it still offers high strategic upside in a growing semiconductor market and is worth keeping open while technical and commercial uncertainty continues to resolve.

This off-the-shelf brand is very close to our established business, likely inexpensive to maintain, and broadens commercialization of existing know-how, so the option value of staying in the market remains high.

Because glass-based circuit boards are relatively distant from our narrow core substrate business and would require continued commitment beyond our main capabilities, the learning gained so far is unlikely to justify further resource allocation.
